title: NIH Notification 2026 - Walk-in interview for Junior Research Fellow Posts
description: The National Institute of Hydrology (NIH) has officially released the notification for 01 Junior Research Fellow posts. Interested and eligible candidates can use this opportunity to apply for these posts before the last date of application. Candidates who have completed their M.Sc. can apply for the NIH Notification 2026 . The interested applicants can attend the walk-in interview.
